summary: Ülo Valk works in religious studies and indology. He studied at Miina Härma Gymnasium and the University of Tartu (~1981–1986), later holding a post at the University of Tartu around 1991 and serving as an editor at Numen.

Ṭhānissaro Bhikkhu works in Buddhist studies. He studied at Oberlin College (~1967–1971) and under Fuang Jotiko (~1976–1986), whom he succeeded. He founded Metta Forest Monastery, where he served as abbot in 1993, and taught Khemako.
